name: OHill Self-Adhesive Cable Clips (16 pack)
caption:
Your charging cable fell behind the desk again. 🔌

These self-adhesive clips stick to the edge of your desk and hold the cable right where you can grab it. You get 16 in the pack, for less than a coffee.

Over 81,000 people have rated them, about 4.4 stars.

Tip: put one on your nightstand and one in the car too. Clean the spot with a little rubbing alcohol first so they stick better.
